query_analysis.original_query: I am struggling to understand why the injection of water make-up suddenly decreases the desorption tower by a significant percentage ? is it related to the heat loss or more like an error in the DCS ?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate the cause of a significant decrease in desorption tower performance following the injection of water make-up, specifically determining if the issue stems from heat loss or a DCS error.

selected_agents.role: Root cause analysis of desorption tower performance drop
Heat loss analysis and impact on desorption

communication_strategy.information_flow: Diagnostic information sharing and hypothesis testing
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Parallel investigation of heat loss and DCS error

clarification_questions: What is the typical operating temperature of the desorption tower?
What is the temperature of the make-up water being injected?
Can you provide any data logs from the DCS around the time of the performance drop?
What is the composition of the feed to the desorption tower?
What is the percentage decrease in the desorption tower performance?
